text.tspan: National average learning outcomes vs. government expenditure per primary student
In order to maximize coverage, the most recent available data were used for both the learning outcomes (2005-2015) and expenditure data
(2006-2014). National average learning outcomes correspond to test scores across standardized, psychometrically-robust international and
Average harmonised learning outcome score in 2005-2015 (Angrist et al., 2019)
Data source: Angrist et al. (2019); World Bank EdStats (2019)
